title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Unified Agent Platforms: Google Cloud introduced its new Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to build, scale, and optimize enterprise-grade agents, while Rippling launched automated SOC 2 compliance using its unified stack.

Brazil structural under-allocation: Market experts at Harvard Club's Brazil Week argue that global investors are missing out on Brazil's clean energy grid (87% clean), massive freshwater reserves, and critical niobium mining dominance.

Copper and AI Power Grid Deficits: With copper prices soaring above $6.50/lb, the demand for EV batteries and AI data center power-grids is driving massive rallies in strategic mineral explorers like NovaRed.

Apple's Restricted Archive: To mark the 50th anniversary of Apple, Tim Cook gave the Wall Street Journal a rare tour of a restricted vault containing early prototypes and legacy hardware never seen by the public.
Mysterious $8M Bitcoin Burn: An old, dormant wallet from 2014/15 was seen permanently destroying 107 BTC (valued at over $8 million) in five independent transactions to a well-known burn address.

Quiet 5 AM Gas Station Walks: A viral family story warmed hearts on X, describing a husband who woke up at 5 AM every morning for 'walks' to a local gas station just to find quiet solitude before his hectic workday.

items.title: @googlecloud: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
items.body: Google Cloud officially launched the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, a new unified platform designed to help enterprises build, scale, govern, and optimize AI agents securely at production scale.

items.title: @stanine: Rippling Automated Compliance
items.body: Rippling CEO Matt MacInnis announced Rippling Automated Compliance, launching first with automated SOC 2 compliance. Rather than just advising on fixes, Rippling leverages its unified control over identity, device management, and HR to automatically keep systems compliant.

items.title: @WSJ: Tim Cook & Apple's 50th Anniversary
items.body: To mark Apple's upcoming 50th anniversary, CEO Tim Cook walked the Wall Street Journal inside a highly restricted, secret archive of early prototypes and legendary hardware, showcasing some legacy designs that even Cook himself had never seen before.

items.title: @TrenchersAI: AI-Native Terminal for Trenchers
items.body: Trenchers AI is launching a waitlist for its new AI-native terminal. The product aims to eliminate the friction of managing multiple tabs, bots, and tools by providing a unified command interface built specifically for power developers and trader-trenchers.

items.title: @_mrchaturvedi: Shrinking macOS System Data
items.body: Developer Parth Chaturvedi shared a highly effective macOS performance trick that successfully shrunk his bloated System Data storage from 10 GB down to just 1.48 GB, acknowledging the credit to Kevin's optimization advice.

items.title: @Astropad: Remote Mac Management for Agents
items.body: Astropad is pitching a free tier offering 20 minutes of remote access per day, aimed at developers who need a quick way to check on autonomous agents, restart stuck build tasks, or monitor processes running on their home Mac.

items.title: @drewcrawford_: The Bull Case for Brazil
items.body: Drew Crawford laid out a compelling thesis at Harvard Club's Brazil Week on why U.S. allocators are drastically under-allocated (less than 1%) in Brazil. He highlights structural assets like holding 12% of the world's fresh water, an 87% clean energy power grid, massive farmable land, deep Pre-salt oil reserves, and CBMM producing over 80% of the world's niobium (critical for next-gen EV batteries and jet engines).

items.title: @VictorRenajlj: The Copper & AI Power-Grid Story
items.body: Victor Renard shared the massive rally in NovaRed Mining ($NRED), up 3,300% in a year, framing it as part of a broader copper supply story. With copper hitting record highs over $6.50/lb, analysts warn of potential deficits by 2026 driven by massive demand from AI data center power-grids, EVs, and military hardware.

items.title: @lanhubiji: Massive Bitcoin Burn Mystery
items.body: A strange event unfolded in crypto where an anonymous user sent a total of 107 BTC (worth over $8 million) in five independent transactions directly to a well-known burn address (1111111111111111111114oLvT2). The sender's address was an old dormant wallet from 2014/15, sparking debates on whether it was a deliberate choice or a tragic error.

items.title: @Goldback: Gold-Backed Physical Divisible Currency
items.body: Goldback is promoting physical, divisible, 24k gold foil currency as a hedge against inflation and the declining purchasing power of the U.S. dollar, which has lost over 96% of its purchasing value since 1913.

items.title: @arc: Building with USDC and Circle
items.body: Circle's Grants and Ventures teams shared details at Arc Studio on how they are funding and supporting early-stage builders and scaling companies building with USDC on the Arc platform.

items.title: @Queen_primis: The 5 AM Gas Station Walk
items.body: A wife secretly followed her husband after he spent three months waking up at 5 AM every morning for 'walks.' She discovered he was simply walking to a local gas station to drink coffee in quiet solitude and mentally prepare for his workday.

items.title: @Amma__tuuh: 14 Missed Calls of a New Father
items.body: A viral family anecdote about a husband who called his healthcare-worker wife 14 times at work because the baby wouldn't stop crying, only to explain: 'I've fed her twice, changed her diaper, rocked her... I think she just likes you more.'

items.title: @helloitsolly: The Austin Apple Pay Scam
items.body: A customer shared a frustrating experience in Austin where a server used Apple Pay's receipt decline flow to secretly add a $10 tip and sign on their behalf, sparking a discussion about merchants exploiting contactless payment flows.

items.title: @eurofounder: Marriage Adjustment List
items.body: A hilarious viral tweet details a couples' contrasting lists of ideas to spice up their relationship, showing the wide gap between romantic ideas like massage oil and much more adventurous solo proposals.
